ORIGINAL CHARACTERS. ORIGINAL CREATORS.

Sources & credits.

The archive contains 97 existing ASCII drawings selected from ASCII Bin, imported on November 24, 2026. Search, cycling, and exports use the original text; common outer indentation and blank padding have been removed for display. Artist signatures remain in the artwork.

ASCII Bin publishes its art collection under CC0 1.0. Its license notes clarify that this dedication covers the compilation and rights held by the collector; some pieces are by other artists whose rights the collector cannot waive. Check the original piece and its creator before reuse that requires permission. This app does not claim to own those drawings.

Each artwork links to its entry in the source collection. Copy and download include that source, and any artist signature in the drawing. If you are a creator seeking a correction or removal, please open an issue identifying the piece.

Visual inspiration: ASCII Art from GameFAQs, collected by Lock Books. This project is independent of Lock Books.
